## Automox - Full-Stack Software Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/automox/jobs/5440188008)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Full-stack engineer building Vue, Java, Laravel, and AWS features for Automox’s cloud-native endpoint-management platform. Owning customer-facing functionality, APIs, data models, testing, and observability.
Full-stack engineer building endpoint-management features for Automox’s cloud-native IT operations platform
- Salary: $130,000 - $150,000 per year
- Tech stack: AWS, Java, JavaScript, Laravel, Node.js, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot, SQL, TypeScript, Vue.js
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Build and ship customer-facing features across the full stack, including Vue components, Laravel, Spring Boot, TypeScript-driven AWS Lambda services, data models, and migrations
- Use AI coding tools and review their output to the same standard as personally written code
- Design and document API endpoints, including pagination, filtering, and error handling for large customer environments
- Instrument releases with logging and metrics, monitor post-release performance, and fix issues identified by data
- Work with product and design to vet the roadmap and turn requirements into technical plans and shippable increments
- Write unit and end-to-end tests
- Review code and participate in code reviews
- Improve performance, technical debt, and maintainability
- Three or more years building and shipping enterprise web applications
- Proficiency in TypeScript with a modern component framework; Vue preferred
- Server-side development experience in an object-oriented language; Java with Spring Boot and Typescript on Node.js preferred
- Working knowledge of relational and non-relational databases, including SQL and an eye for queries that won't scale
- Experience writing automated tests for the code you ship
- Strong written communication
- Passion for solving customer problems
- Experience working with fast-moving cross-functional teams including engineering, design, and product

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Full-stack engineer building Vue, Java, Laravel, and AWS features for Automox’s cloud-native endpoint-management platform. Owning customer-facing functionality, APIs, data models, testing, and observability.
Full-stack engineer building endpoint-management features for Automox’s cloud-native IT operations platform
Role description:
• Build and ship customer-facing features across the full stack, including Vue components, Laravel, Spring Boot, TypeScript-driven AWS Lambda services, data models, and migrations
• Use AI coding tools and review their output to the same standard as personally written code
• Design and document API endpoints, including pagination, filtering, and error handling for large customer environments
• Instrument releases with logging and metrics, monitor post-release performance, and fix issues identified by data
• Work with product and design to vet the roadmap and turn requirements into technical plans and shippable increments
• Write unit and end-to-end tests
• Review code and participate in code reviews
• Improve performance, technical debt, and maintainability
• Participate in the team's on-call rotation
• Contribute to the shared component library
• Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and Quality Engineers
• Regularly ship features to customers and own feature development end to end
Role requirements:
• Three or more years building and shipping enterprise web applications
• Proficiency in TypeScript with a modern component framework; Vue preferred
• Server-side development experience in an object-oriented language; Java with Spring Boot and Typescript on Node.js preferred
• Working knowledge of relational and non-relational databases, including SQL and an eye for queries that won't scale
• Experience writing automated tests for the code you ship
• Strong written communication
• Passion for solving customer problems
• Experience working with fast-moving cross-functional teams including engineering, design, and product
• Experience breaking complex functionality into a simple technical design
• Comfort moving between a Vue component and a database query in the same day
• An interest in continuous learning and sharing your knowledge with others
• An ability to drive changes in technology and processes with humility and tact
• A sense of ownership and curiosity that keeps you with a problem until you understand it
• Must be able to pass a federal, state, county background check
• Complete a local in-person verification
• Not able to sponsor work visas at this time
Benefits:
• Equity for Full-Time Employees
• 401K Match
• Flexible PTO, generous sick time policy
• Comprehensive Health Plans with generous employer contributions
• 100% Company-paid Short Term/Long Term Disability and Life Insurance
• Company HSA Contribution: $100-$200 per month based on tier
• $25 per month Lifestyle Spending Account
• Internet Reimbursement - $50/month
• $500 Home office stipend
• $10k Adoption Benefit
• Comprehensive Family Planning Covered on Meritian Medical Plan
• Competitive Salary
Tech stack:
AWS, Java, JavaScript, Laravel, Node.js, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot, SQL, TypeScript, Vue.js
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsH1B=true.
